critical_code_review_comments: student_invoices.py:_next_invoice_number() uses find_one_and_update with return_document=True (motor accepts int 1 for AFTER). Includes robust fallback re-read if the response shape differs. Concurrency test confirms strictly monotonic sequence under parallel load.

business_settings.py get_or_create_settings() is idempotent and safe under concurrent GETs. PATCH filters only non-None fields, preserving unchanged fields — verified by test_patch_only_supplied_fields_change.
student_invoices.py list_all_invoices() enriches with student name via a single $in lookup — no N+1 problem. Good.
invoice_pdf.py build_invoice_pdf() output verified with pdfinfo: proper A4, %PDF + %%EOF, content-disposition includes RE-YYYY-NNNN.pdf filename.
fahrkontrolle_pdf.py page 2 correctly injects Fortschritt-Chart with per-category horizontal bars + Gesamt-% + Kommentare-pro-Lektion section. All 6 category headers legibly render on page 1.
Frontend AccountingPage.jsx correctly guards each sub-tab with data-testid attributes (accounting-subtab-*), year selector maintains state, KPIs bind to /api/accounting/summary response.
BusinessSettingsManager.jsx exposes all 17 fields with individual bs-* testids and onBlur autosave hint banner. Good UX pattern.

context_for_next_testing_agent: For iteration 30/31 features specifically use test files test_iteration30_31_accounting.py + test_iteration30_31_extras.py. Both use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var (with fallback to preview URL). Note the ATOMIC INVOICE COUNTER is scoped to calendar year — pytest-xdist parallel workers hit the counter simultaneously, so consecutive-sequence assertions fail (correctly), only assert monotonic ordering. The Fahrkontrolle PDF is now 2 pages ALWAYS (page 1 = matrix, page 2 = chart + journal). Legacy `test_iteration27_pdf_extra.py::test_pdf_single_page_when_no_comments` is now obsolete — main agent should update. To open Buchhaltung UI use /admin?tab=accounting. To open InvoicesTab click the RECHNUNGEN sub-tab (URL deep-link ?tab=invoices on student page does NOT auto-switch — click the tab explicitly).
rca of the issue: No RCA needed — no critical bugs. Two minor observations: (1) URL deep-link ?tab=invoices on AdminStudentDetail is ignored on cold navigation, likely because AdminStudentDetail initial state resolves to default tab before URL params are hydrated. Fix: read URL param inside useEffect on mount and setActiveTab. (2) Legacy iteration-27 test expects Fahrkontrolle PDF to be 1 page when no comments — spec now mandates page 2 chart always, so update the assertion.
